text:
Your job will replace you in a week if it has to.

Plan accordingly.

Nobody is coming to save you.

Not your boss. Not HR. Not a raise.

You build your own way out.

thread:
BUILD ALONGSIDE YOUR JOB. HERE'S HOW TO FIND THE TIME:

1. 5 hours a week is enough for one product.
2. 1 hour on 3 weeknights. 2 hours on Saturday.
3. Cut one thing: the scroll, the show, the side hustle research.
4. Work on the product only. Not the logo. Not the website.

By the end of the year you'll have more than most people get from a whole year of "planning."

Follow @bylovemason if you're done with your 9-5.
